init.title: Configure printer and Bambu account
init.description: The LAN provider connects directly to the printer. Optional account sign-in makes your filament, print and machine profiles and MakerWorld available in Studio. Start cloud profile synchronization manually under Profiles. The password is used only for this sign-in and is not stored. If a token already exists, password and email remain optional. Current token status: {cloud_token_status}. LAN access code: {lan_code_status}. Slicer key status: {slicer_secret_status}. Connection check: {slicer_connection_status}.

data.slicer_api_secret: Slicer API secret (will not be shown again)
